rca_of_issue: Root cause is environment/data publication split, not app auth/proxy failure. Reproduction: same approved phone logs into both hosts with isolated cookie jars -> different UIDs, different PYQ catalogue totals (0 vs 30), and source IDs return 404 on live /my/sets. Mitigation: keep current app env untouched until owner confirms desired shared backend/history strategy; if switching/testing, use explicit isolated transport to avoid silently changing user history scope.
